title: TC-TIB-029 — [Edge] Quick-fill from inline GO to layer does not copy items (intentional)
steps:
Preconditions: Global Option (Additional Option, source = Create new) with items; an artwork layer eligible for Quick-fill from this GO

  1. On the layer, use Quick-fill sourced from this inline GO
expectedResult: The layer does NOT receive a copy of the GO's inline items (intentional — confirmed by dev comment, not a bug).
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, artwork #4572 on campaign 2730. GO 986 (inline Additional Option, layer-226664) and GO 987 (category-sourced, layer-513136) exist on this artwork.

Setup performed for this case: added a new "Single-line Text" layer to artwork #4572, opened its Personalization Settings > Populate Values > enabled "Populate Content from another option", and inspected the "Source option" dropdown (this is the Quick-fill mechanism).

Observed (direct):

  • With only the Additional Option layers (GO 986, GO 987) and the text layer itself present, the "Source option" dropdown for Quick-fill showed "List is empty." — neither inline GO layer was offered as a source.
  • As a control, a second "Single-line Text" layer was added to the same artwork. Re-opening the first text layer's Quick-fill source dropdown now listed that second text layer ("Text layer") as an eligible, selectable source. This confirms the dropdown correctly surfaces eligible layers when they exist, and that it specifically excludes the inline Additional Option GO layers — not a generic/broken empty state.

Conclusion: Quick-fill (Populate Content from another option) does not offer an inline Additional Option GO as a source at all, so there is no mechanism by which its items could be copied into another layer via Quick-fill. Matches the intentional behavior described in the ticket. No bug found.

Note: two extra "Single-line Text" layers were added to artwork #4572 for this test; left in place on staging per standing "no cleanup" instruction (unsaved — artwork was not saved/closed with these added, since the comparison was done in the editor's live unsaved state). If a persisted copy is needed later, this would need to be redone and explicitly saved.
